title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::

items.text: It is very hard to get out of bed every Monday morning.
Even though my mother shouts at me to wake up I don't want to get up.
I want to stay in bed longer.
My weekdays are similar to other students.
From Monday to Friday I go to school and academies.
Sometimes I feel like I study too much.
But I am happy to learn new things and play with my friends.
Every night I chat on the computer with my friends.
It is a great way to exchange information about homework.
I often do my homework on the computer as well.
Sometimes I watch TV or listen to music before I go to bed.
Friday night is my favorite because it is the start of the weekend.
I reflect on things that did not go well during the week.
I plan for the next week to be a better week.
